description: Rewrites the campaign's own texts around facts that already changed, and only the parts the host picked: the registration page copy (description, countdown headline, main headline, sales copy) and the emails (confirmation and reminders 1 to 5), nothing else. The thank-you page, the webinar name and the room info text are NOT written by this tool, because the copy writer does not fill them: the name moves with wi_change_webinar_title, a single stored line with wi_change_webinar_settings, any other wording with wi_change_webinar_text. WITHOUT `confirm` true nothing is written: the answer is the preview of which parts would be rewritten, one line each, so the host can pick. With `confirm` true the chosen parts are rewritten by the same copy writer the build uses, the untouched parts stay exactly as they were, and the answer names what really changed. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id` and `targets`. Facts move FIRST: a date with wi_change_webinar_schedule, the name with wi_change_webinar_title, a single wording with wi_change_webinar_text. For ONE wording use wi_change_webinar_text, which is exact and costs nothing.

confirm.description: true actually rewrites the chosen parts. Leave it out to get the preview first and let the host pick.

primary_goal.description: What should be different for the participants afterwards, if that changed.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

target_audience.description: Who the webinar is for, if that changed.

targets.description: Which parts to rewrite: the registration page copy, the emails, or all of them. These are the only parts this tool can write.

topic.description: The topic, if it changed and the new copy should know it.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_rewrite_webinar_texts
title: Rewrite the webinar texts after the facts changed
